requirements.name: To satisfy, complete 7 priority A method of treating cancer comprising: 1.1 administering pembrolizumab (anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody which comprises a heavy chain and a light chain, wherein the heavy and light chains comprise SEQ ID NO:21 and SEQ ID NO:22; see Study Patents) and axitinib (an VEGF receptors inhibitor: N-methyl-2-[3-((E)-2-pyridin-2-yl-vinyl)-1H-indazol-6-ylsulfanyl]-benzamide; marketed under the brand name Inlyta); 1.2 wherein the cancer is bladder cancer, breast cancer, clear cell kidney cancer, head/neck squamous cell carcinoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, malignant melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer, ovarian cancer, pancreatic cancer, prostate cancer, renal cell cancer, small-cell lung cancer, triple negative breast cancer, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, acute myeloid leukemia, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, chronic myeloid leukemia, diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, Hodgkin's lymphoma, mantle cell lymphoma, multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndrome, non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, or small lymphocytic lymphoma. 1.3 wherein the renal cell carcinoma is an advanced renal cell carcinoma that is predominantly clear-cell subtype with primary tumor resected; 1.4 wherein axitinib is administered at a starting dose of 5 mg twice daily (i.e., “BID” or “B.I.D.”) 1.5 wherein if the individual tolerates axitinib with no drug-related grade >2 adverse events for two consecutive weeks, the dose of Axitinib is then increased to a maximum dose of 10 mg BID (i.e., twice daily); 1.6 wherein if the dose combination is not tolerated, the dose of axitinib is then reduced to a minimum dose of 3 mg BID (i.e., twice daily); 1.7 wherein pembrolizumab is administered at a dose of 1 mg/kg every three weeks (i.e., “Q3W”), 2 mg/kg Q3W, or 200 mg Q3W.
